description: This Java class provides utility methods for implementing a WebDAV servlet, including date formatting, XML document parsing from HTTP requests, and extracting user credentials from requests.

classes.name: WebDavUtil
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for WebDAV operations such as date formatting, XML parsing, and credential extraction.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on the provided format string, using GMT timezone.

methods.name: getDocumentFromRequest
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML Document from the HttpServletRequest's input stream.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts user credentials from request parameters or HTTP Basic Authorization header, returning a map with login.username and login.password.

methods.name: getRFC1123DateFormat
methods.description: Returns the RFC1123 date format string used for date formatting.
